Resolves #21519

Both big data grids open under a header: a headline and one line on what to try, with the ☰ button at its right end instead of on the column header. Opening Settings pads the view's right edge, so the grid ends left of the panel instead of running under it. The cause of today's look: #9634 removed the grid's `.neo-grid-wrapper` node in April, and both examples kept styling it, so the band above the grid and the room for the panel had matched nothing since. The big data grid's nested component is now a pill tinted with the grid's accent. Covers re-shot in neomjs/pages#141.

Evidence: L3 (live Chromium at 1440×900 and 1024×768, dark and light; e2e on both examples; covers re-shot) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-6).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: new arm "the headline holds the Settings button…" in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/BigDataNL.spec.mjs` and `TreeBigData.spec.mjs` (headline text; button bottom at or above the grid's top). Outside-CI: frames below; light theme checked live in both examples |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same arms, open (grid right edge at or left of the panel) |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: neither `index.html` is in the diff, so neither page title changes |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: neomjs/pages#141's file table (two 1280 × 720 covers with sha256) |
| AC-5 | Outside-CI: the 17 e2e specs that load either folder, `npm run test-e2e -- …` locally: 63 passed (2.9 min); after the chip, `ComponentCellScrollSync` and `BigDataNL`: 6 passed |
| AC-6 | Outside-CI: computed styles live; the chips are opaque, so the text reads 7.08 : 1 in dark on any row, the selected `#64B5F6` one included, and 7.71 : 1 in light (WCAG formula, measured colours) |

## Deltas from ticket

- The cover recipes anchor the 640 × 360 crop on the grid (`offsetX: -16`, `offsetY: -12`, viewport 640 × 451). A crop from the page's top spent a quarter of the frame on the headline that the card's caption repeats right below it. The tree recipe's checked row moves from "John Thompson" to "Pod 4": in the new frame John Thompson sits under the footer, so the old check passed on a row the cover does not show.
- The class that makes room moves from the grid (`neo-extend-margin-right`) to the view (`neo-controls-expanded`), so the header makes room too.
- The chip came from the operator mid-lane; it shares this cover cycle, so it is AC-6 here rather than a second ticket.
